Question 3
?

cosh⁡4=

a
12(e4−e−4)
b
12(e−4−e4)
c
12(e4+e−4)
d
12(e1/4+e−1/4)
e
12(e1/4−e−1/4)
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

The definition of cosh⁡x is cosh⁡x=12(ex+e−x).

Therefore, cosh⁡4=12(e4+e−4).
